neighbours.label: first piece of a multi-token word for a publication or media product (period|icals, best|-selling, box| office, white|papers, ball|ad)
fire: The shop sells used paperbacks and old comics.
The firm released two whitepapers on cloud security.
Her memoir became a best-seller within a month.
The library subscribes to forty scholarly periodicals.
The sequel earned record box office takings in Asia.
He listens to three podcasts on his commute.
The band recorded a slow ballad for the album.
The archive holds rare broadsheets from the 1700s.
quiet: The shop sells used furniture and old lamps.
The firm painted two white walls in the new office.
Her memoir was the best thing she ever wrote.
The library was closed for a short period in spring.
The sequel was shipped in a cardboard box to Asia.
He listens to the radio on his commute.
The band played a slow song at the ball.
The archive holds rare maps from the 1700s.

notes: card/look: period(icals) x3, box (office), best(-selling), mild(ew), white(papers), ball(ad), Ze(its)chriften. Mostly media/publication words; mildew does not fit.
